name: fair_deal_toyota_camry
description: Solid mainstream deal: 2022 Camry LE priced at market, sane financing, clean fees. Should land mid-to-high with no critical flags. Baseline sanity case.

input.user_message: Analyze this deal: 2022 Toyota Camry LE, used, 35,000 miles, priced at $22,400. Located in TX (ZIP 75001). Financing at 6.9% APR for 60 months with $4,500 down, no trade-in. name: predatory_deal_honda_civic

name: good_price_junk_fi_rav4
description: The classic dealer trap: fair vehicle price on a 2023 RAV4 XLE, but $4,497 of F&I/add-on stacking plus a marked-up 9.9% APR for good credit. Tests that add-on and APR factors independently drag a market-priced deal to mediocre. This is the Negotiation Arena's best demo case — every flagged item is negotiable.
